messages.subject: Analytics Competition
messages.body_plain:
Folks,
If  the summer is going slow and you need something interesting to
do:), check out the Hearst Challenge contest.  www.hearstchallenge.com <http://www.hearstchallenge.com>
.

This years contest involves  developing email targeting models and is
co-sponsored by Hearst, DMA and Wharton.
$25,000 and there is an innovation prize for $5k  as well.

Regards,
Krishna
